kits.name: wedding
kits.label: Wedding
kits.recipe: Elegant wedding reception. On every table: one floor-length white tablecloth, one floral centerpiece at the table center, and two candles 0.55 m either side of the center along the table. Swap every chair to the gold chiavari chair. Add one dance floor (about 4 x 2.5 m) in the best open area near the front of the stage; if loose chairs (not at a table) are in the way, remove them. Center one flower arch on the stage. Hang string lights across the hall, about 7 strands evenly spaced along the room width, running front to back. Keep all aisles >= 44 in and exits clear.

kits.name: theater
kits.label: Theater
kits.recipe: Theater / keynote setup. Remove all tables (keep fixed building items). Place chairs in straight rows facing the stage, centered on the stage, with a 44-in center aisle aligned with the stage center and 44-in side aisles along the walls; first row ~1 m from the stage front; row pitch ~0.92 m; seat pitch ~0.52 m; skip seats that would collide with columns or block exits. Stop at the requested guest count. Add a black curtain behind the stage (stage width + 3 m), two spotlights on stands at the front corners of the stage aimed at it, and a red aisle runner down the center aisle.

kits.name: conference
kits.label: Conference
kits.recipe: Classroom conference: tables in rows facing the stage with 2-3 chairs per table on the stage-facing side, a center aisle, podium on stage, screens on.
